representation_fit.evidence: Primary object is a change_set rendered as a causal change timeline, directly matching the brief's understand × temporal-sequence shape: day-grouped timeline of 29 change records (1280x860 viewport; data at source/index.html:108-243), before/after change tables per record (app.js:184-188), causal chain strip with 根因▸/▸结果 endpoints (1280x860 top pane; app.js:157-172), and time-ordered state replay folding set-operations (right pane; app.js:40-53).

primary_task_salience.evidence: The initial screen is dominated by the change timeline (~60% of left column at 1280x860) with a pre-selected record, its causal chain strip at top, and detail + replay panes on the right; the success criterion '变更因果可读' is surfaced via 上游·因/下游·果 tags on timeline rows and 上游因果/下游结果 blocks in the detail pane (1280x860 viewport; app.js:140-141, 192-197).

time_to_understand.evidence: Model-judged proxy: title 'Meridian 变更时序档案 / ChangeSet Timeline' (1280x860 header), window digest '5 个工作日 · 3 起 SEV 事件 · 2 次应急回退 · 全部闭环' (1280x860 windowline; index.html:71), validation pill '时序校验 ✓ 29/29 有序 · 24/24 因果「因先于果」', and usage hints on both panes (index.html:33, 52) make what/where legible immediately; no loading state (app.js:284-288 synchronous init).

navigation_cost.evidence: Primary object reachable in 0 clicks on load (default selection c02 with chain, detail, and replay populated; app.js:56 'S.sel: "c02"') and 1 click for any other record via a single delegated click handler on timeline rows, chain links, and link chips (app.js:257-281); deep-link hash #sel/asof/fc/ft reproduces any state (app.js:237-254; demonstrated in source/shots/02-04).

context_loss.evidence: All actions are in-place re-renders with no mode change: filter chips keep selection and even retain filtered-out causal relatives marked 链路保留 (app.js:113-117, 142); replay slider updates only the replay pane (app.js:282); full state (sel/asof/fc/ft) persists to the URL hash on every render (app.js:246-254).

ui_surface_complexity.evidence: Single screen with one pane per job (chain, timeline, detail, replay — index.html:28-61) and no redundant modes; but 18 always-visible filter chips (7 component + 11 type, 1280x860 filter rows; index.html:72-93, app.js:102-109) exceed strict need, though the type chips double as a color legend.

accessibility.evidence: Good: real <button> elements for chips/links/locbtn (app.js:79-80, 104-108, 165-166, 198), aria-label on the replay slider (index.html:54), lang=zh-CN (index.html:2). Gaps: timeline event rows — the primary interaction targets — are <article>s with cursor:pointer but no tabindex/role/keyboard activation (app.js:143-150, 257-258); chips are ~22px tall targets (styles.css:99-103); small 10.5-11px text in --mut2 #5a6b7f on #0b0f14 ≈3.5:1, below AA (styles.css:4, 40, 67, 146). All receipt a11y checks unavailable (see missing_evidence).

frontend_rework.evidence: No visible layout defects at either viewport: 1280x860 and 1440x900 both show clean two-column layout, no overlap or truncation (chain strip clips at 1280 via intentional overflow-x:auto, styles.css:75-79). Header stats are internally consistent with source data: 29 events (index.html:108-243), 24 causal edges (sum of causes arrays), 12 observation records (OBS_TYPES filter app.js:67, 88) — matching the on-screen pill and stat block (1280x860 header). No error failures: checks layout.overflow, layout.responsive_collision, text.truncation, a11y.contrast, a11y.focus_order, a11y.target_size, type.min_projected_size all 'skipped', 0 fail (measurement-summary.json:4-18).

acceptance_seed_coverage.evidence: Seed '时间结构与变更语义一致' is explicitly engineered and self-verified: startup check that all events are time-ordered and every causal edge satisfies 因先于果, surfaced as the header pill (app.js:19-25, 90-96; 1280x860 '✓ 29/29 有序 · 24/24'), events sorted by timestamp before render (app.js:6), chain nodes sorted by time (app.js:159-160), replay folds set-ops in time order (app.js:45-51).

defects_observed: Timeline event rows (the primary click targets) are not keyboard-focusable or activatable — <article data-id> with click-only delegation, no tabindex/role/keydown (app.js:143-150, 257-281)
Filter chips are small targets (~22px tall, 11.5px font; styles.css:99-103) and several small text labels use --mut2 #5a6b7f ≈3.5:1 contrast on the dark background (styles.css:4, 40, 67, 146)

At 1280x860 the causal chain strip clips mid-chip at the right edge (c09/c10 partially cut); functional via overflow-x:auto scroll (styles.css:75-79) but the full chain is not visible at once at this viewport
missing_evidence: All seven receipt checks are 'skipped' with target_invalid: true (measurement-summary.json:4-18) — no objective measurements for layout.overflow, layout.responsive_collision, text.truncation, a11y.contrast, a11y.focus_order, a11y.target_size, type.min_projected_size
task_completion_time, information_retrieval_accuracy, human_preference: no user study exists in this pilot (per rubric); model preference is not human preference
scores.overall_note: The package presents a change_set timeline whose representation matches the brief's understand × temporal-sequence cell almost exactly: a day-grouped change timeline, a causal chain strip with explicit root-cause/result endpoints, per-record before/after tables, and a time-ordered state replay, all available on first paint with a pre-selected record (zero navigation to the primary object) and preserved context across filtering via 链路保留 closure retention and URL-hash state. The acceptance seed is not merely addressed but machine-checked in the UI (29/29 ordered, 24/24 causal edges cause-before-effect), and the displayed stats reconcile with the source data. Deductions are confined to accessibility: keyboard-inaccessible timeline rows, sub-24px chip targets, and some sub-AA small muted text; and the receipt summary supplies no objective confirmation either way, since all seven checks were skipped against an invalid target — visible layout at 1280x860 and 1440x900 is otherwise clean and internally consistent.
